# clamp is max(lo, min(x, hi)) in every backend, matching the declaration's own
# body. Go and JS emitted the opposite composition and Kotlin used coerceIn,
# which throws when lo > hi rather than answering lo.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=outjs app.sngl
grep 'Math.max\(0, Math.min\(' outjs/index.html

sngl generate --lang=kotlin --platform=android --opt=main=true --out=outkt app.sngl
grep 'maxOf\(0, minOf\(' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'coerceIn' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component main {
    var raw int = 42
    var v int = int.clamp(raw, 0, 10)
    text(value="{v}")
}
